result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is a clear untranslated localization key rendered as a section heading, plus a couple of smaller inconsistencies in the favorite-button styling and carousel card labeling.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key and ensure a sensible fallback (e.g. the English label) is shown when a key is missing.

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use inconsistent styling: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent background with a white heart, making the control look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color and opacity) across all restaurant cards regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel have inconsistent image backgrounds — the first card (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey background while the others use dark photographic backgrounds, so its white time badge has low contrast against the light area.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment or a subtle dark gradient scrim behind badges so the delivery-time text remains legible on all card artwork.
